findings.event: Domestic (Korea) and international (PCT) composition patents registered covering SC co-formulation of HyDiffuse with 11 named antibodies (incl. dupilumab)
findings.summary: New untracked competitor: Huons Lab's in-house rHuPH20 hyaluronidase platform HyDiffuse now has registered composition patents for SC co-formulation with 11 antibodies (pembrolizumab, bevacizumab, obinutuzumab, ramucirumab, donanemab, isatuximab, durvalumab, dostarlimab, cetuximab, risankizumab, dupilumab), with nonclinical PK data showing 113-170% higher Cmax and 117-162% higher AUC vs. antibody alone.
